Location: India - Remote

**About Turing**
================

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

**About the Role**

Turing is looking for a high-caliber Product Manager to lead critical product areas across our talent, marketplace, vetting, and platform ecosystem. This person will step into a high-ownership role and should be able to combine strong product judgment, design taste, data-driven decision making, technical fluency, and structured business thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of user experience, systems thinking, analytics, and execution — someone who is equally comfortable shaping product direction, defining elegant user experiences, and driving cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment.

**Why this role matters**

Turing works with many of the world’s leading AI labs and enterprises to help build, improve, and scale advanced AI systems. We sit at the intersection of frontier AI, high-quality talent, and complex product/platform workflows - which means the problems here are real, hard, and highly consequential.

This role sits at the core of how Turing builds scalable, high-quality experiences across talent and customer workflows. The right person will help raise the bar on product execution, clarity of thinking, and quality of experience across the organization.

**What you’ll own**

You will lead product strategy and execution across some of Turing’s most important platform surfaces, including areas such as:

* Talent discovery, search, and matching
* Talent onboarding and profile quality
* Vetting, trust, and integrity systems
* Marketplace workflows and hiring manager experience
* Internal platforms and operational tooling
* Cross-functional product initiatives spanning product, engineering, design, data, and operations

**What you’ll do**

* Own roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a core product area
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured product plans, clear requirements, and strong execution
* Drive product development with a sharp eye for user experience, workflow design, and quality
* Use data deeply to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, prioritize investments, and measure impact
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, QA, and operations to ship high-quality products quickly
* Balance short-term execution with long-term product and platform thinking
* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities

**What we’re looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems
* High ownership, urgency, and a strong bias for execution

**Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or a similarly rigorous discipline, ideally from a top-tier institution such as IIT or equivalent globally recognized universities
* MBA from a top-tier university is a plus, but not required
* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products
* Strong track record of partnering closely with engineering and design teams to ship polished, high-quality user experiences

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**
----------

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**Advantages of joining Turing**
--------------------------------

* **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
* **Contribute to leading-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
* **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
* **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
* **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.
  

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

* Experience leading cross-functional teams across the full product lifecycle, from defining product vision and requirements through launch, measurement, and iteration

Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

**What we do...**

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

**About the Product Manager role...**

This is a full-stack product role with a primary focus on GDS connectivity within the distribution portfolio. You will lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and opportunity identification through requirements definition, delivery, go-to-market, and post-launch evaluation. Working closely with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will shape product direction, support feature delivery, and define clear success measures to ensure outcomes align with customer needs and business goals.

**What you'll do...**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and customer validation through requirements definition, delivery, launch, and evaluation.

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

**About the team**
------------------

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance.
* A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
* A collaborative office environment and team events.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. * Lead brand and product marketing activities for Allergan Aesthetics India to drive growth, customer engagement, and business performance.
* Own the end-to-end brand strategy across the product life cycle, including new product launches, campaign development, performance tracking, and optimization.
* Work effectively in a matrix organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver business objectives in alignment with AbbVie values.

**Purpose of the Role**

The Brand / Product Manager is responsible for driving the strategic and operational management of an assigned brand or product portfolio within Allergan Aesthetics India. This role leads brand growth through robust marketing strategy, customer insight, data-driven decision-making, and effective cross-functional execution. The position owns key elements of the product life cycle, including launch planning, campaign execution, performance tracking, and lifecycle optimization, while operating in alignment with AbbVie values, business priorities, and compliance expectations.

This is a highly visible, leadership-oriented role requiring strong influence across a matrix organization, with accountability for delivering results through collaboration, insight, and disciplined execution.

* Develop and execute integrated brand plans and marketing strategies aligned to business objectives, market dynamics, and portfolio priorities.
* Lead product life cycle management across launch, growth, maturity, and optimization phases.
* Own new product launch planning and execution, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, readiness, rollout, and post-launch tracking.
* Design and implement multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, field, and customer-facing initiatives.
* Define, track, and report key performance indicators to measure campaign effectiveness, brand performance, and return on investment.
* Conduct primary and secondary market research to generate actionable insights on customers, consumers, competitors, and market trends.
* Map customer and consumer journeys to identify opportunities to improve engagement and impact at each touchpoint.

**DESCRIPTION**

About Amazon Business:  
Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.  
At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.
  
  
The Role:  
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?  
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.  
  
The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.  
  
We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:  
  
1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.  
  
2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
  

* Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
* Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
* Outbound channels — email and push notifications
* Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

  
You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
* Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels
* Customer Understanding: Develop deep understanding of business customer lifecycle patterns, procurement behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we engage customers
* Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels
* Marketing Automation: Build and scale marketing automation systems that enable personalized, multi-channel customer journeys — from acquisition through retention — with self-serve tooling for marketing team
* Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
* Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
* Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming launch plan and resolve open dependencies.

* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner

* Understand user journeys, business logic, database relationships, API integrations, and application architecture.

* Develop reliable workflows rather than depending on unstructured prompts alone.
* Implement observability, tracing, evaluation datasets, token and latency monitoring, and cost controls.
* Know when to use a deterministic workflow instead of an autonomous agent.

**Relevant technologies:** OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, vector databases, and other relevant agent orchestration frameworks.

3. AI-Assisted & Agentic Software Development

* Work effectively with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and other AI-assisted development environments.
* Use AI coding agents for implementation, debugging, refactoring, test generation, code review, and documentation.
* Create reusable project instructions, coding standards, agent skills, tool integrations, and repeatable development workflows.
* Design multi-step coding workflows with planning, implementation, testing, review, and validation.
* Understand the code being generated rather than blindly accepting AI-generated output.
* Review AI-generated code for security vulnerabilities, incorrect business logic, performance problems, and maintainability.
* Use Git-based version control, pull requests, branch protection, and code review practices.
* Establish a repeatable workflow for moving from an idea or prompt to tested, deployable software.

4. Full-Stack Development & System Architecture

* Understand and work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, authentication, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Build and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces.
* Design REST APIs and understand GraphQL where appropriate.
* Implement authentication, role-based access control, permissions, session management, and secure data handling.
* Design database schemas, migrations, indexes, relationships, transactions, and query optimization.
* Integrate payment gateways, messaging systems, maps, analytics, AI services, and third-party platforms.
* Understand modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven systems, background jobs, and asynchronous processing.
* Diagnose issues across the entire stack instead of treating frontend and backend as isolated components.

**Preferred technologies:** TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, and other equivalent production-grade technologies.

5. Automated Deployment & DevOps

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, builds, deployments, and release verification.
* Configure development, staging, and production environments.
* Manage environment variables, secrets, configuration, and database migrations safely.
* Work with GitHub Actions, Docker, cloud hosting, managed databases, and deployment platforms.
* Automate build validation, linting, type checks, test execution, security scanning, and release workflows.
* Implement deployment verification, health checks, rollback procedures, and recovery plans.
* Understand containerization, infrastructure configuration, networking, logs, and application runtime environments.
* Manage production releases with minimal downtime and controlled risk.
* Troubleshoot failed deployments, dependency conflicts, build errors, server issues, and environment-specific bugs.

**Relevant tools:** GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, AWS, GCP, Azure, Railway, Render, Supabase, and Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools.

6. Quality Assurance & Production Readiness

* Build a reliable testing strategy covering unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and regression testing.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Vitest, Jest, or equivalent frameworks.
* Verify critical business flows before releases, including authentication, payments, bookings, notifications, and admin operations.
* Identify race conditions, edge cases, inconsistent data, permission errors, and failure scenarios.
* Implement structured logging, error tracking, uptime monitoring, and application performance monitoring.
* Use tools such as Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and cloud-native monitoring solutions.
* Establish production-readiness checklists, incident response procedures, backup policies, and disaster recovery practices.
* Ensure that an application is not considered complete merely because it works on a developer's machine.

7. Security, Reliability & Scalability

* Apply secure coding practices and follow relevant OWASP guidance.
* Prevent common vulnerabilities such as injection, broken access control, exposed secrets, and insecure API endpoints.
* Protect user data and implement appropriate authorization, validation, rate limiting, and audit logging.
* Understand secure authentication flows, password handling, OAuth, and token management.
* Manage database backups, recovery procedures, dependency vulnerabilities, and access permissions.
* Identify scalability bottlenecks and optimize database queries, API response times, caching, and background processing.
* Establish sensible controls for AI tool permissions, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and unsafe agent actions.

8. Technical Documentation & Engineering Operations

* Maintain a clear inventory of all applications, repositories, environments, domains, integrations, and deployment pipelines.
* Document architecture, setup instructions, environment configuration, dependencies, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Track technical debt, recurring production issues, service dependencies, and infrastructure costs.
* Create reusable templates and standards so new applications can be launched consistently.
* Ensure that no critical system depends entirely on undocumented knowledge held by one individual.

* **Product engineering:** Requirements gathering, feature prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, and product lifecycle ownership.

* **Cloud and infrastructure:** Practical experience deploying and operating real applications.
* **Testing:** Automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* **Production operations:** Logs, monitoring, incident diagnosis, backups, performance, and reliability.
* **Security:** Secrets management, authorization, secure API design, and dependency management.
* **Technical communication:** Ability to explain architecture, trade-offs, risks, and implementation decisions clearly.

What We Expect From You

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

**Where the GO of MetaGO happens!**

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

* **Fun Personality:** People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.
* **Superstar:** That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

**Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)**

description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

title: Engineering Product Manager
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. **DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Leads complex product management work, programs, projects, or initiatives across a broad area of responsibility in alignment with product, departmental, functional, and business objectives.  
2. Translates business plans, client needs, product priorities, and functional objectives into actionable recommendations, work plans, and execution approaches.

5. Identifies and resolves complex product, process, operational, or client-related issues by analyzing information from multiple sources, applying sound judgment, and leveraging appropriate resources within and outside the function.  
6. Recommends and implements best practices, product enhancements, service improvements, and process changes that strengthen efficiency, quality, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.  
7. Leads or contributes to high-impact initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, influence, change management, and execution discipline across the product life cycle.  
8. Uses data, metrics, reporting, market or client insights, and performance information to guide decisions, evaluate outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.  
9. Develops and maintains strong strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff, functional partners, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and sustained performance.
